brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Book a technician visit to diagnose and repair an unusual engine noise in my car.
facts: My 2018 sedan is making a high-pitched squealing noise whenever the engine is idling.
The car is parked at my home address.
I am available any weekday morning this coming week.
preferences: I prefer morning appointments over afternoon slots.
I prefer confirmation sent via text message if given the option.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, though they may not be able to quote a price until they see the problem

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, new installations on 2, billing on 3.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: Automated Greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Auto Care. Please listen carefully as our menu options have recently changed.

script.label: Automated Menu
script.text: For service, press 1. For new installations, press 2. For billing, press 3.

script.label: Representative Greeting
script.text: Thanks for holding, you have reached service scheduling. My name is Mark, how can I help you today?

script.label: Ask Vehicle Details
script.text: I can certainly help you schedule a visit for that. Could you please give me the year, make, and model of the vehicle?

script.label: Pricing Policy
script.text: Just so you are aware, we cannot quote a price over the phone until a technician sees the problem in person.

script.label: Pause to Check Schedule
script.text: Let me check our schedule for our mobile technicians. Please hold on for just a moment while I pull up the calendar.

script.label: Silence While Checking
script.text: ...Still looking through the available slots here, thank you for your patience...

script.label: Offer Appointment Window
script.text: I have an opening for this Tuesday between 8:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Would that time window work for you?

script.label: Ask Address
script.text: Great, could you please provide the service address where the technician should arrive?

script.label: Booking Confirmation
script.text: You are all set for Tuesday between 8:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Our technician will call you when they are on their way.

script.label: Closing
script.text: Thank you for choosing Apex Auto Care. Have a great day!

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
